name: Mitsuhashi Hirono
source:
Hirono is the childhood friend of Michio and [url=https://vndb.org/c32448]Minori[/url], she is also the older sister of [url=https://vndb.org/c32449]Wakana[/url]. She plays the role of the big sister of the three others.
Always listening to others, she is appreciated by all. She is gentle and her presence is reassuring.
She has a habit of hugging people she likes, to the delight of Michio, who has always fantasized about his incredible chest. Just like her younger sister, she noticed the change of attitude of Minori and will gladly follow Michio in his room when he comes to ask her (false) advices.
She is one of the few people Michio really loves.

She is the third "actress" of Michio, he'll makes her sleeps by drugging her and will use her breasts for a boobjob. She has no memory of it since she was sleeping under the influence of drugs. 

She will later follow Michio because of a "trickery" : to don't touch and have sex with her younger sister (~lol~).
She then follows Michio in his plan for his revenge without being blackmailed.

[spoiler]She forgives Michio for her "rape" because in reality she had been in love with him since the very beginning and the only thing that really drove her was to being filmed for her first time.
She is competing against her sister to "capture" Michio's heart.[/spoiler]
